purpose: replace incompatible HCA/CSA/raw-local v1 factorization with one source-faithful layer grammar, entry identity, compressor isolation, and causal experiment order while preserving all valid parent, quality, state, and systems gates

HCA: causal completed-entry emission and explicit unfinished tail
language, retrieval, composition, compression-sufficiency, state, compute, and realized systems gates
CSA: parent HCA operator selection before CSA
oracle-first selector feasibility before mean-key and learned indexers
separate selector/language gradient paths and execution modes
explicit index, compressed-entry, tail, HCA, local, and recurrent state accounting
raw_local: shared query representation within a compressed-attention layer
exact causal raw ring and prefix/eviction/resume identities
local-specific quality endpoints and explicit added-state cost
window selected only after parent mechanisms qualify

corrected_layer_grammar.HCA_core: dense attention to every causally complete non-overlapping HCA entry without raw local entries; mechanism-isolation diagnostic only
corrected_layer_grammar.HCA_local: source-faithful HCA: raw local window concatenated with every causally complete HCA entry
corrected_layer_grammar.CSA_core: attention to indexer-selected causally complete overlapping CSA entries without raw local entries; mechanism-isolation diagnostic only
corrected_layer_grammar.CSA_local: source-faithful CSA: raw local window concatenated with indexer-selected causally complete CSA entries
corrected_layer_grammar.schedule_unit: assignment of exactly one available type to each independently selected exact-global integration slot
corrected_layer_grammar.schedule_rule: HCA and CSA complement one another through different slots in depth; no same-layer coarse HCA branch is retained during a CSA-layer intervention

CSA.source_span_for_first_entry: current a-half [0,m-1]; previous b-half is padded

raw_local.visibility: self and earlier positions under the causal local window

deduplication.reason: distinct learned projections/pooling and representation families carry different information even when source-token support overlaps

one_softmax_union.HCA_local_entries: raw exact window entries plus every causally complete HCA compressed entry plus one sink logit
one_softmax_union.CSA_local_entries: raw exact window entries plus selected causally complete CSA compressed entries plus one sink logit
one_softmax_union.HCA_core_entries: every causally complete HCA compressed entry plus one sink logit
one_softmax_union.CSA_core_entries: selected causally complete CSA compressed entries plus one sink logit
one_softmax_union.normalization: one source-axis softmax denominator per query head; the sink contributes only to the denominator

fixed_across_arms: compression rate and exact block identities
layer slots, local-branch state, precision, data, optimization, and evaluation

arms.weights: one learned position logit shared across channels
one learned position logit per output channel
hidden-to-channel score projection plus learned position-by-channel bias, softmax over positions

HCA_compressor_isolation_v2.parameter_accounting: score projection and static position parameters are reported separately; downstream compensation cannot hide compressor cost
HCA_compressor_isolation_v2.selection: choose the simplest arm passing compression-sufficiency and language/capability floors on held-out cells before any rate grid

CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.compressor_control: selected HCA dynamic compressor adapted to non-overlapping m-token entries at the CSA rate
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.overlap_intervention: replace one projection/score half with separate current-a and previous-b halves and one 2m per-channel softmax
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.first_entry_padding: previous-b values zero and logits negative infinity
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.oracle_unit: causally complete CSA compressed entry with its full ordered source-span set
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.oracle_target: dense teacher probability mass aggregated onto compressed entry identities, not raw block indices
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.unfinished_current_entry: excluded from compressed selection; any current-block access is supplied by the separately frozen raw local window
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.head_sharing: one selected compressed-entry set shared across main MQA query heads
CSA_compressor_and_selector_v2.token_level_escape_hatch: requires a successor showing compressed-entry oracle failure and a realizable token-level oracle win

raw_local_v2.placement: one local raw ring in every selected HCA_local or CSA_local slot; placement ablation is separate
raw_local_v2.query: shared main attention query for the layer
raw_local_v2.keys_values: exact raw projected/normalized KV identities for min(history,W) most recent causal tokens
raw_local_v2.union: concatenate raw identities with the layer's HCA or selected CSA compressed identities before one softmax
raw_local_v2.deduplication: remove only repeated exact raw cache indices or repeated exact compressed cache indices; never remove across representation families
raw_local_v2.current_query: may attend to itself and earlier raw tokens; no unfinished compressed entry
raw_local_v2.state: raw ring chronology/write position plus HCA or CSA compressor tails and completed entries are distinct

source_reference_modes: one full prefill at start position zero
source_reference_does_not_cover: multiple request identities in reused nonpersistent buffers
local_successor_must_cover: full versus every partition of chunked prefill
chunked prefill followed by one-token decode
prefix hits ending at every offset modulo m, m', and W
independent request interleaving and cache-slot reuse
eviction/serialization/resume of raw ring, HCA tail, CSA prior/current halves, and completed entries

ordered_experiment_sequence: select recurrent backbone, exact cache representation, global-slot count/placement, and positional treatment
isolate four HCA compressor arms at one fixed rate in HCA_core slots
select HCA_core rate on a held-out rate grid
isolate raw-local window by comparing selected HCA_core with HCA_local at the same slots
qualify non-overlap versus source-overlap CSA compression at fixed rate and selected local window
run oracle compressed-entry selection before mean-key and learned indexer
freeze one CSA_local operator, then compare all-HCA_local, all-CSA_local, and preregistered interleaved slot schedules
only after operator and schedule selection, run independent ratio/placement and long-horizon confirmation

registration_and_stop_boundary.stop_before: active finalist acceptance and independent parent selection
registration_and_stop_boundary.next_action: preserve this corrected factorization; do not implement or expand sequence compression until the active finalist and parent gates close

decision.next_action: wait for active finalist acceptance and independent parent selection; then freeze source identities and CPU correctness protocols in the eight-stage order
